author: More Perfect Union
description:
One hundred former members of Congress are lobbying for authoritarian regimes.

The regimes want American weapons, and they found the people to help make that happen.

These former members of Congress are also pushing for regime change — and with Trump they’re getting it.

Producer/Host: Nick Cleveland-Stout
Editor: Andrew Rivera
Coordinating Producer: Leah Abrams
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How Saudi Arabia bought itself a U.S. Defense Secretary
